entities.summary: The Schumann House is a cultural site in Leipzig in Germany. The musicians Robert Schumann and his wife Clara lived here for their first four years of marriage; there are now exhibition rooms in their former apartment, about their life and work. Schumann-Haus is a museum in Europe, established in 1838. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
